decisions.reason: The firm built a dedicated page for this chart plugin, it extends the established web-map offer, and it was launched only a year ago, so weak early results can still be blamed on a slow ramp-up.

The hierarchical search plugin is only mentioned on the website, which signals little public commitment, but it is cheap to maintain within the web-map plugin family and fits the firm's integration direction.
Featuring the mobile layer control on the home page is a highly visible commitment that management would feel obliged to justify, so it will persist with the product.
The GIS platform is a multi-model product line with heavy investment and sits at the core of the firm's announced enterprise-solutions strategy, which makes dropping it very unlikely.

Mobile field data capture has its own page, matches the firm's push toward mobile and integrated workflows, and serves public-sector customers who adopt slowly, so disappointing early results look temporary.
The firm visibly committed to this search extension with a dedicated page, though its overlap with Product B makes it a somewhat more plausible candidate for consolidation.
